# Support

- **Questions / how-to:** [Discussions → Q&A](https://github.com/Zolexora/Zolexora_Platform/discussions/categories/q-a)
- **Bugs and feature requests:** [new issue](https://github.com/Zolexora/Zolexora_Platform/issues/new/choose) (pick the form for your product)
- **Security vulnerabilities:** privately, per [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)
- **Docs first:** [README](../README.md), [docs/](../docs/), and `products/<name>/README.md`

Before asking about a product that fails to start: check `infisical login` and that the product's Infisical folder has every key listed in [docs/secrets.md](../docs/secrets.md).
